notes: OJZ act 1's layer-switch lines (LINES-EVERYWHERE, 2026-09-26). Format: tools/layer_lines.py. These four replace the sixteen painted crossover marks that section 0's loop carried until then (column 143, editor rows 52-55 and 68-71: XOVER_TO_B on plane A, XOVER_TO_A on plane B). A marked column was entered RIGHTWARD across its left edge (x 1144) and LEFTWARD across its right edge (x 1152), so each edge of each four-cell bar becomes a line, and every line carries both marks' meaning: crossing right puts the player on plane B (the right arc) at high priority, crossing left puts him on plane A (the left arc) at low priority. The marks derived priority from the plane (B high, A low); these lines set exactly that. Not grounded-only: a mark fired airborne too.
